title: argyreia calcicola
intro: Argyreia calcicola, commonly known as Indian pickler or morning glory vine, is a plant species in the Convolvulaceae family. It has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, as well as its use as a laxative and diuretic. The therapeutic actions of Argyreia calcicola are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, although further research is needed to fully understand its chemical composition and potential applications.
